name: sales-bd-team
description: Sources people and organizations actively signaling demand for what you sell, enriches and scores them against your ICP, then drafts and sends outreach and logs the resulting deal activity. 3 roles: Lori (Prospect Scout), Alex (BD Research), Sarah (BD Execution). interface.longDescription: An AI Team of three specialized Digital Employees: Lori scouts people and organizations showing active demand signals, Alex enriches and scores them against your ICP, and Sarah drafts and sends outreach and logs deal activity. Bring your own ICP, enrichment tool, and send-from configuration.
